//: EMULATOR-ONLY CONFIG. scripts/start-dev.ps1 passes it with `--config firebase.emulators.json`. It exists because the Storage emulator refuses to start under a real project id without a `storage.rules` key (`Cannot start the Storage emulator without rules file specified in firebase.json`), and that key in firebase.json would let a bare `firebase deploy` push storage.rules -- the PERMISSIVE emulator ruleset -- to production. Keeping the key here, in a file `firebase deploy` never reads by default, keeps firebase.json unable to touch rules, exactly as its own `//` comments require for Firestore. Production Storage rules live in the console; the review copy is storage.rules.prod.
